O.location: plot area at the Week 1 x-axis label
O.content: The blue bar aligned with the printed label "Week 1" has a top below the horizontal dashed line.

O.location: horizontal dashed line near the 550 y-axis tick
O.content: The dashed horizontal line is inscribed "Average" at its right end.
The axis is inscribed "Revenue" and has printed ticks including 450, 500, 550, and 600.

B.text: If the bars encode weekly revenue with higher vertical position meaning greater revenue, the Week 1 bar is bound to the Week 1 label, and the dashed line labeled "Average" is the applicable revenue-average benchmark, then a Week 1 bar below that line indicates below-average Week 1 revenue. If the routing form uses below-average revenue as the criterion for low-revenue response, select the low-revenue option.
B.conditions: Applies to the Cafe C chart and Week 1. The chart does not state an explicit routing threshold or policy, so the final low-revenue routing relation is an assumed task interpretation.
